featured_reviews.review_text:
Update March 2025

The food remains great, however the service was seriously slack. They were seriously understaffed and while our server (Sameer) was a great guy he truly struggled to get to all the tables. The older waiters and the manager (Nilesh) were of not much help. We tried giving constructive feedback to the manager but he just did not show for 5 minutes. Frustrated we left - Never to return.

xxxxx

An upscale take on traditional south Indian food. The place offers dishes from the entire west coast of India from konkani to Goan to malayali cuisine.

Their sea food thali hits all the right notes, starting with the amazing chutneys, papads and masala filled deep fried chillis going to the mains which had a mix of coastal preparations.

Their prawns in kokam garlic and fish allepey are to die for. The rassam to start your meal is the perfect level of spice with an incredible amount of flavour.

Do try their feni cocktails, will transport you to goa instantly.

All in all a great place, with amazing service and brilliant food.

A special thanks to laxmikant who was attentive and accomodating to our requests.

A place worthy of the Taj tag.

featured_reviews.name: Ranjith Menon
featured_reviews.review_text: The most amazing dining experience. We were served by Mr. Laxmikant and he was outstanding. His knowledge of the menu and his food recommendations were fantastic. The food- the taste and the presentation was simply fabulous and I would definitely recommend the sea food thali (go for the unlimited version). Another recommendation that I thought was fantastic was the kori ghee roast. Try the kelpulachi vade as a starter and you’ll thank me for it (actually you can thank Mr. Laxmikant 😄). The solkadi drink was refreshing too and is a perfect way to get the evening started. The icing on the cake was a surprise chocolate mousse that was presented to my niece who was celebrating her 15th birthday. The whole ritual around birthday celebration at the Konkan cafe is a spectacle in itself .. so if you are celebrating a birthday, make sure to head to konkan cafe. All in all - a terrific dining experience and I am pretty sure Ill be back the next time I am in India

featured_reviews.name: Saquib Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Central Lunch Home, nestled in the vibrant neighborhood of Cuffe Parade, stands out for its delectable seafood offerings and authentic Mangalorean cuisine. One of their standout dishes is the Bombil Fry, a crispy delight that perfectly balances the delicate flavors of the fish with a tantalizing blend of spices. Each bite offers a satisfying crunch, making it an absolute must-try for seafood enthusiasts.

Another gem on their menu is the Mangalorean Style Chicken Sukkha, a rich and aromatic dish that bursts with flavors. The tender chicken pieces are marinated in a blend of traditional spices, cooked to perfection, and then simmered in a luscious coconut-based gravy. It's a dish that showcases the culinary prowess of Central Lunch Home's chefs and keeps patrons coming back for more.

For those looking for a hearty and fulfilling meal, the Egg Masala is a top choice. This dish features boiled eggs cooked in a flavorful masala gravy, infused with spices that pack a punch. It's a comforting dish that pairs well with rice or bread, making it a favorite among diners.

One of the most appealing aspects of Central Lunch Home is its affordability. Despite offering high-quality seafood and authentic dishes, the prices remain reasonable, making it accessible to a wide range of customers. Additionally, the portion sizes are generous, ensuring that diners leave fully satisfied.

However, it's worth noting that Central Lunch Home can get quite busy during peak hours, which might result in longer wait times. Nevertheless, the bustling atmosphere adds to the charm of the place, creating an authentic dining experience.

In summary, Central Lunch Home at Cuffe Parade is a haven for seafood lovers and aficionados of Mangalorean cuisine. With its affordable prices, generous portions, and high-quality food, it's no wonder why this restaurant is a favorite among locals and visitors alike. Whether you're craving Bombil Fry, Mangalorean Style Chicken Sukkha, or Egg Masala, Central Lunch Home delivers on taste, making every visit a memorable culinary adventure.

After a while, the waiter came with my order and provided me the bill, I checked as it said 240 including gst which became 252. Got the correct change and I left. But when I checked Zomato, I noticed that the price of a chicken biryani is 210 and for 240 one can get Chicken Tikka Biryani. I found that a bit strange since I didn't eat inside and just got my order and left. Anyways, I thought I should share with you because I felt the receptionist's behaviour was quite rude. I know, I have written way too much about this minor incident, but I had to share it nonetheless.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Pratap Lunch Home is a great spot if you’re craving prawns or fish. I tried their butter garlic prawns (4/5), tawa surmai fry (4/5), and Chettinad prawn biryani (4/5). It’s a chill place with a coastal vibe and homely food—highly recommend for a quick lunch.
Top Dishes
•	Butter garlic prawns: Fresh and flavorful, hitting all the right garlicky notes without overpowering the seafood.
•	Tawa surmai fry: Crispy edges with balanced spices, showcasing the fish’s natural freshness.
•	Chettinad prawn biryani: Spicy, aromatic, and generously portioned for a satisfying coastal twist.
Vibe and Service
The relaxed, sea-inspired ambience pairs perfectly with the comforting, home-style cooking. Quick service makes it ideal for lunch breaks in the Fort area.

featured_reviews.name: Niki Mitra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Discover the flavors of the sea at Pratap Lunch Home, a hidden restaurant de fruits de mer in the heart of Fort, Mumbai! This seafood and non-veg lover's paradise is a must-visit for any food enthusiast.

The LOVE:

- Delicious Food: The dishes are packed with flavor, and the portions are generous.
- Friendly Staff: The team is attentive and welcoming, making sure you feel at home.
- Cozy Ambiance: The AC section is a blessing, especially during peak hours.
- Alcohol Served: With a 10% VAT, you can pair your meal with a drink of your choice.

Must-Try Dishes:

- Mutton Bhuna: Tender, spicy, and utterly addictive. The quantity is impressive, and the quality shines through.
- Prawns Chilly Roast: Fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. A must-try for seafood lovers.

We were impressed by the food, service, and ambiance. While peak hours can get busy, the wait is worth it. We're already planning our next visit to try more of their menu offerings.

If you're a seafood or non-veg lover, Pratap Lunch Home is a must-visit destination. With its rich flavors and cozy atmosphere, it's a great spot for a night out with friends or a special occasion.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great culinary experience having lunch here on a weekday with my family. The place was not crowded at all, the ambience was calm and inviting with a home-like touch. We came with the intention of enjoying seafood and we achieved exactly that. I definitely recommend dining here and Pratap Lunch Home is now on my must-return list!

Food we ordered:
Bombil Fry - A Bombay staple and they did it justice. (5/5)
Lobster Chilly Roast - This was my favourite. Unbelievably good! I also liked how they were transparent in showing us the sizes and prices of the lobster they had in their catch and let us choose as per our preference. (5/5)
King Prawns Ghee Roast - Also really good. (5/5)
Shell Fish Sukka - Good masala but we were not blown away. We also had to be extra careful while eating as not all hard debris were cleaned from the shell fish. (3/5)
Squid Malabar - Crispy fried squid which I couldn't get enough of. (5/5)
Prawns Vijaywada - Decently flavoured prawns curry. (4/5)
Mutton Tawa Pulao - I've never had pulao done so well. Good sized portion too. (5/5)

featured_reviews.name: dhawal gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stepping into Bayroute in Cuffe Parade is less like walking into a restaurant and more like embarking on an enchanting journey across the Mediterranean and Middle East. From the moment you cross the threshold, the attention to detail in the ambience, the authentic depth of the cuisine, and the seamless service work in perfect harmony to deliver an unforgettable fine-dining experience.

The Ambience: An Arabian Night's Dream
The ambience at Bayroute is truly its soul, beautifully capturing the old-world charm and opulence of the Levant. The decor is a magnificent blend of Moroccan, Turkish, and Arabian influences. Warm, rich lighting spills over intricately patterned floor tiles and tastefully adorned walls, which feature beautiful Turkish art. The seating is plush and comfortable, with Moroccan printed sofas that invite a leisurely, communal dining experience.

The entire space exudes a refined yet cozy atmosphere—perfect for a romantic evening, a sophisticated family dinner, or celebrating a special occasion. It’s an aesthetically curated masterpiece where every corner offers a visual delight, transporting you far away from the hustle of Mumbai.

The Food: An Authentic and Flavorful Expedition
The menu is an extensive map of culinary delights from countries like Egypt, Turkey, Lebanon, and Greece. It's a testament to authentic, well-researched cuisine, and every dish we tried was a revelation.The ingredients taste fresh, and the authentic spices are used with a delicate hand, ensuring the dishes are flavorful without being overwhelmingly heavy.

The Service: Courteous and Impeccable

A superb meal is only elevated by excellent service, and Bayroute truly shines here. The staff is exceptionally courteous, knowledgeable, and attentive. Our server was well-versed in the menu, offering insightful recommendations and patiently explaining the different regional nuances of the dishes. The pacing of the meal was perfect—neither rushed nor slow—allowing us to fully enjoy the experience. The attention to detail, from refreshing water glasses to clearing plates promptly, was seamless and professional.

Bayrute is more than just a restaurant; it’s a cultural experience. While it is on the higher end of the pricing scale, the unparalleled ambience, the authentic and delicious food, and the impeccable, friendly service make it absolutely worth the indulgence. It remains a must-visit destination for anyone looking to sample the finest Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisine in Mumbai in a truly magnificent setting.

featured_reviews.name: Monica
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re craving an authentic Middle Eastern experience in Mumbai, BAYROUTE is a place you simply can’t miss. We visited their Cuffe Parade outlet, and honestly, it felt like stepping straight into an Arabian dining room, warm, inviting, and rich in flavours.

Let’s start with their Classic Hummus, because that’s a non-negotiable order here. Creamy, smooth, and beautifully balanced, it’s topped with pine nuts, finished with labneh, and generously drizzled with good quality extra virgin olive oil. Simple, classic, and done perfectly, exactly how hummus should be.

For a refreshing sip, we tried their Reyhan, a soft beverage made with muddled orange and basil. Super refreshing, fragrant, and a great palate cleanser alongside the heavier dishes.

The Cheese Manakeesh was another standout. A soft Middle Eastern flatbread brushed with olive oil, loaded with lots of cheese. Comforting, indulgent, and perfect for sharing.

One of the highlights of the meal was the Dijaj Tria, a roasted trio of chicken kebabs featuring harissa spiced chicken, creamy shish taouk and Saffron Joojeh, served with garlic sauce, spicy schug and a punchy acili ezme dip. Every skewer brought something different to the table, and all of them were cooked beautifully.

Seafood lovers will enjoy the Butter Garlic Prawns, juicy, well-seasoned, and finished with rich garlic butter flavours without overpowering the prawns themselves.

We wrapped up with the Yemeni Mandi, which was aromatic, flavourful, and comforting, a wholesome dish that truly completes the Middle Eastern feast.

Overall, BAYROUTE delivers a genuine Arabian dining experience, from flavours to ambience. Perfect for anyone who enjoys Lebanese, Turkish, and Middle Eastern cuisine under one roof.

featured_reviews.name: Debabrata Golder
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are a seafood lover looking for an authentic and budget-friendly meal near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CST), Sandeep Gomantak Hotel is an absolute must-visit.
Getting There & Parking
The restaurant is incredibly convenient if you are traveling by train, located just a short 5 to 7-minute walk from the CST station. I highly recommend that you go by walk only. Because it is situated in a bustling, crowded area, there is absolutely no parking available. Trying to find a spot for your vehicle nearby is a major problem and will only add unnecessary hassle to your meal, so walking is definitely the smartest option.
Ambiance & Service
Despite being a busy eatery, the management does a great job of maintaining the space. The dining area is kept very neat and clean, making for a comfortable environment to enjoy your meal. Additionally, the service is impressively fast. The staff is efficient and attentive, ensuring you get your food quickly even during peak lunch or dinner hours.
The Food
The star of the show here is undoubtedly the authentic Konkan-style cooking. The fish items are perfectly spiced, incredibly fresh, and exceptionally tasty. What makes it even better is that everything is well under budget, offering fantastic value for money without compromising on flavor. If you visit, you absolutely must try the crab—it is wonderfully prepared and easily one of the standout dishes on the menu.
Verdict
Overall, Sandeep Gomantak offers a fantastic, no-frills dining experience that hits all the right notes for coastal food cravings. Fast service, clean surroundings, and mouth-watering seafood make it a true hidden gem. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Adil Syed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Location & Popularity
Bagdadi is located in a prime area of Colaba, making it easily accessible and always buzzing with people. The restaurant is extremely popular, especially during evening hours, which clearly reflects its strong reputation among food lovers.

Waiting Time
Due to the heavy rush during peak hours, particularly in the evenings, customers usually have to wait for their turn. While the wait can be a bit long, it also speaks volumes about how loved the food here is.

Food Quality
The food at Bagdadi is genuinely great. The flavors are rich, consistent, and worth coming back for. It’s one of those places where the taste truly lives up to the hype.

Ambience & Renovation (Personal Opinion)
In my personal opinion, the restaurant could really benefit from a renovation. The place feels a bit dated, and a refresh would greatly enhance the dining experience without taking away from its old-school charm.

Final Verdict
Bagdadi is a must-visit for its excellent food and prime Colaba location. Despite the waiting time and the need for renovation, the taste and authenticity make it well worth the experience—especially for those who don’t mind a little wait for good food.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Just experienced a fantastic meal at the iconic Bharat Excellensea, a 35-year-old gem in Mumbai's Ballard Estate! The restaurant has been recently revamped, and the ambiance is now even more inviting. But the real star is the food!

As a self-proclaimed seafood addict, I was in heaven. I sampled a wide range of dishes, each bursting with flavor and freshness.

The Tom Kha Soup was a fragrant and comforting start. The Prawns Butter Garlic were perfectly cooked and incredibly flavorful. The *Yellow Chili Prawns  packed a delicious spicy punch. The Surmai Masala Fry was a classic done exceptionally well. The Thalasseri Clams were a fiery delight, showcasing the flavors of Kerala. The Rawas Gassi was a rich and creamy Mangalorean-style curry. The Neer Dosa and Appam were the perfect accompaniments to soak up the delicious gravies.

But the real surprise was the Sitaphal Tricones Holige! This innovative dessert was a delightful fusion of Indian and modern flavors. A must-try!

Overall:
Bharat Excellensea is a must-visit for any seafood lover in Mumbai. The restaurant offers a wide variety of fresh, flavorful dishes with influences from across India's coastal regions. The recent revamp has enhanced the dining experience, making it a perfect spot for a special occasion or a memorable meal. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Biswas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Waited for 15 minutes to get a place.
They serve all sorts of packet Chaknas here like Moong Dal, Chakli, Seng, Chana, Roasted Chana Etc. These are all reasonably priced between 20 to 40.

We order Bombil Fry, Chicken Sukka, Kori Rotti and Neer Dosa & Solkadi
Being married to a Mangalorean and been a regular to Mangalorean outlets back in Kudla I know the taste very well. This was nowhere near sadly. The Bombil Fry being a Maharashtrian special was just oil fried with light red batter rather than Rawa Fry. Killed the appetite completely unfortunately. It was served a small bowl of Coconut gravy which was again very bland.

The Chicken Sukka was too bland. Quantity was ample but the taste was honestly bland. I tried to finish it with the Neer Dosa since Bhakri wasn't available.

Neer Dosa again was served with a small bowl of Coconut gravy as usual bland.

The Kori Rotti being a staple food amongst mangaloreans was a major let down. It didn't have any flavor and even had sasive(Mustard) in it which was unlike of any Mangalorean Outlet. My wife finished it with a lot of difficulty.

The only savior was the Solkadi and it was really tasty and thick. It was too good and cheap at the same time.

Overall verdict is it's a cheap and pocket friendly place. The food was 2/5. Drinks are probably cheap since everyone was busy consuming that. Solkadi 6/5. The staff were always on the feet and ready to attend.

featured_reviews.name: Kamlesh Madgavkar
featured_reviews.review_text:

The neer dosa was not thin, not thick.. Just perfect. Less oily food. You don't feel stuffed. They serve red unpolished rice too. The service by staff was humble and courteous.
Its a decent spot for good nonveg meals. They serve alcohol too.

I had the pleasure of dining at Hammer & Songs on 16th October for a team dinner — a lovely evening that took an unexpected turn. featured_reviews.name: Indradeep Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Entry from Gate 2. Late evening normally there is not much rush and you can park on your own. Else valet is intermittently available.

Earlier there was an open air section that is now covered permanently. However, as the ceiling covers are too high you can continue to feel it as an open air space.

Visited with my friend and we wanted to have a quick drink with an appetiser and share a large plate. We opted for Kashmiri Kena which was undoubtedly wonderful with liberal sprinkle of Kashmiri spices.  In the main course we opted for their signature pot rice with chicken with sauteed vegetables. It was a bit bland although we enjoyed it for its overall portion of vegetables and the taste. You can obviously request to make it spicy in case you want to.

The host was very warm and welcome. We got a lot of help to place our orders and patiently explained about the foods that we opted for.

Importantly no noise so we had a wonderful conversation going. We loved this

Definitely a great place I would like to visit a few times with my friends and family.

There is an indoor section which can be booked for a private party. The toilet is outside the restaurant but was well maintained.

featured_reviews.name: Ariez Tata
featured_reviews.review_text: The food here is best and most flavourful cuisine I had ever eaten in a very long time! Even in a place like Mumbai which has thousands of amazing restaurants, this stood out! It was outstanding because the flavour of all the dishes was absolutely amazing! I can’t wait to go there and eat again! Check out the pictures of all the food! The Galouti kebab, sitafal ice cream and the mushroom truffle risotto were outstanding!

featured_reviews.review_text: The restaurant is located on the ground floor of World trade centre compleax near gate no 2. They have a buffet during the lunch time which cost Rs 1200+taxes. The buffet spread is varied and has burmese, chinese, indian, continental and Nepali cuisine. They also have a live counter for chaat, paani Puri and sev puri. They also serve mocktails at the table. Flamboyante, located at World Trade Centre, Cuffe Parade, is one of Mumbai’s most elegant dining destinations. The restaurant offers a beautiful mix of Mediterranean, Asian, and Indian cuisines, all served in a setting that’s as sophisticated as it is relaxed. The décor is lush and artistic.

Every dish is crafted with attention to detail — from wood-fired pizzas and sushi to grilled kebabs, chats, paani puries and mocktails, everything tastes fresh and flavorful. The service is professional yet friendly, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable.

Tips:

Book a table in advance, especially for dinner or weekends.

Perfect for romantic celebrations, or elegant brunches.

Request: Please add biriyani in then non veg section.

A classy spot that truly lives up to its name — flamboyant and unforgettable! ✨🍽️

featured_reviews.name: mayuresh m
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Mahesh Lunch Home and had a wonderful dining experience. We tried the Butter Garlic Prawns, Crab Lollipop, Jumbo Tawa Prawns, and Chicken Biryani. The seafood was fresh, perfectly cooked, and packed with flavor. The Butter Garlic Prawns were rich and delicious, while the Jumbo Tawa Prawns stood out with their excellent seasoning. The Crab Lollipop was crispy and enjoyable, and the Chicken Biryani was aromatic and satisfying.

A special mention for their Solkadi, which is always on the darker side. While it has a distinctive flavor, I feel a slightly lighter preparation could bring more subtlety and balance, making it even more refreshing and enjoyable to sip alongside the seafood.

The service was attentive, and the overall ambiance made for a great meal. Definitely a place worth visiting for seafood lovers. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Renny Justine
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a very satisfying dining experience here. The Surumai tawa fish fry was excellent—perfectly cooked with a great balance of spices that enhanced the flavour of the fish without being too heavy. The Chicken Chettinad was amazing—rich, aromatic, and authentic, with a well-rounded masala that really stood out. The squid was also quite tasty, fresh, and cooked just right.

The place itself has a nice ambience, is clean and hygienic, and the overall quality of food is clearly well maintained. The staff are very friendly, polite, and attentive, which adds positively to the experience.

While the prices are on the higher side, the quality, hygiene, and taste justify the cost. A good place for quality food and a relaxed dining experience—definitely worth a visit. Only issue is Parking. Better to go in a taxi.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Mobarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Mahesh Lunch Home and had a very good experience overall.

The food was excellent, especially the seafood. The squid and prawns biryani were very tasty, well-cooked, and full of flavor. The mojito was refreshing and complemented the meal nicely.

The vibe of the place is great, making it a perfect spot for lunch with a comfortable and lively atmosphere.

Prices are a bit on the higher side, but the taste and quality make it worth it.

Overall, a great place to enjoy seafood and have a good dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Daddyslittlelunchbox
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mahesh Lunch Lounge was an absolute standout and easily one of our best meals in India. We chose to eat here over the Taj after it was strongly recommended by locals — and we are so glad we listened. From start to finish, the experience was fantastic.

The food was exceptional, especially the seafood. The tiger prawns were MASSIVE — genuinely some of the biggest prawns we’ve ever seen, let alone eaten. They were cooked perfectly, full of flavour, and without doubt the best prawns we had in India. That’s saying something, especially as we truly believed Kerala couldn’t be beaten when it came to seafood.

Service was attentive and efficient without being overbearing, and the prices were surprisingly good for the quality and portion sizes. One bit of advice: order your starters before committing to mains — the portions are generous and we definitely over-ordered because everything sounded too good to miss (no regrets, just very full 😅).

Overall, Mahesh Lunch Lounge completely lived up to the hype and then some. Incredible food, huge portions, great service, and excellent value. If you’re debating where to eat — go here.

Follow ➡️ @daddylittlelunchbox

Nestled in the heart of Colaba Causeway, this small, Parsi-run café has a warm, old-world charm and serves delicious, comforting food. Everything we ordered was excellent, but the standouts were definitely the Beef Teriyaki, Butter Garlic Beef Steak, and the Mixed Grill Lasagna. featured_reviews.name: travofood
featured_reviews.review_text: Good food with great hospitality. A bit cramped seating,though ...... But well, that's there for every Mumbai eatery.the lamb shank was really good. For the garlic bread, it was the normal pav bread with 🧄 c flavour. The icecream soda was one of a kind. Earlier ,we used to get these in Calcutta....not anymore. featured_reviews.name: Cassiee
featured_reviews.review_text:
The cafe of the month for me. The food was top-notch, brimming with flavour. From the delish Chicken Cordan Blue to the rich Tiramisu. A bit pricey but definitely a value for money in this economy.

Not only that, but the ambience and atmosphere, chefs kiss. Lovely old ladies, people from all around the world, fresh desserts being served and a mini crossword puzzle too! What an experience!

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Tipnis
featured_reviews.review_text:
A small eatery which is one of the older ones on Colaba Causeway. Right on the main street, it has barely 4-5 tables with minimal elbow room; but its USP is the wide variety of continental dishes including beef (buffalo meat only, since cow meat is banned in Maharashtra).

Tried their King Solomon Steak, but it was too well-done for my liking rendering it chewy - would've preferred it medium or medium-rare. The fish dish was quite good; overall do visit if you are a fan of non-Indian, non-Asian fare, and want a large no. of options to choose from.

Absolutely no parking available anywhere, so do use public transport (BEST Colaba Bus Depot / Electric House bus stop is just next to this restaurant) or cabs!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Lovely restaurant in colaba. It's a small place with table sharing system on busy days. The sausages in firecracker sauce was our favorite, very juicy and flavourful.
The mixed grill lasagna was absolutely perfect, full of meat and cheat.
The beef(buff) teriyaki was top class, do not miss it. You'll clean the plate.
Crumb fried sausages were okay though, nothing special, you can skip it.

Next time we'll try the lamb chops and other dishes. Their overwhelming nenu has something for everyone. Can't wait to go again.

featured_reviews.name: Shivesh Bhatt
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let's start with the 40 minute wait. When you're made to wait that long, you naturally expect something rewarding at the end of it...The ambience was good, and after waiting so long to get a table, we were genuinely happy to finally be seated. The place is moderately expensive, and honestly, nobody mind paying a premium if the experience justifies it. Unfortunately, the service here was pathetic

My friend asked for a bottle of water and specifically requested one at normal temperature. Even after more than 30 minutes, it didn't arrive. When it finally did, they brought chilled water instead. I understand weekends are busy and service may take longer than usual, but taking that much time for a simple bottle of water is ridiculous

Not wanting to waste any more time, we ordered Masala Papad. When it arrived, it had no sev on it. Upon asking, we were casually told that they didn't have available. At the prices you're charging, are customers supposed to simply accept a poorer experience without question?

Then came the next masterpiece. One of my friends ordered a Diet Coke. After waiting more than 10 minutes, the waiter brought a regular Coke. At that point, all of us started laughing because it had become almost comical. When we asked whether they even had Diet Coke, he confidently said they did. The problem was that he had already opened the regular can before asking to change it.

Unfortunately, the experience didn't stop there. We ordered Tandoori Rotis, and the first round arrived burnt to the point that they looked like coal. We told the waiter and politely requested that the next be made properly. The second round arrived looking exactly the same. When we pointed it out, the waiter simply replied, "Weekend hai sir, ho jata hai"

For God's sake, man, we're here to enjoy our weekend too. Why are you ruining the experience?

Throughout the evening, we kept laughing at all the things that kept going wrong because otherwise it would have been frustrating. But when the bill arrived, I genuinely felt compelled to write this review. I rarely leave negative reviews and have never written one this harsh before, but this experience left me with no choice :,)

featured_reviews.name: Sanchit Kamath
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at Colaba Causeway, this mughlai place is a pretty old and one of the legendary eateries which the city has to offer

The place has a royal ambiance but i believe they are definitely in a need of upgrade now.. especially the upper floors. The service is good.. initially it took a while for them to serve us as there was a huge corporate group having their party but once they had their attention to us.. they made sure that we are served well!

We went there for lunch, we ordered:
1) Roomali Roti: The roti was literally soft like a cushion and melts in your mouth, this is one of the best Roomali roti I have ever had.

2) Chicken Bhuna: Made on tawa, this boneless chicken bhuna was actually delicious. Chicken cooked was soft and melting in my mouth whereas the masala had right amount of spices to it and wasn't spicy which was to my liking!

3) Chicken Tikka Biryani: Usually the highlight of the restaurant, but to my surprise the biryani was better than what I had 1.5 years ago as it seems their chef has changed. The last time when I had it, the chicken was really dry and had been marinated in red color.. though it was charred well but was too dry! Whereas this time the tikka was properly marinated and grilled to the right amount leaving the chicken juicy and tender. The quantity served was good too. The rice i believe could have been more fluffier.

4) Sweet Fresh lime soda: The lemon concentrate at the bottom mixed with sugar and added soda.. mixed well.. definitely was refreshing but i wish they could add the fresh lemon juice for better taste.

Overall, a good place to have your fulfilling dinner.. the place had originally introduced to me by my mother.. though it might have changed over the time but still manages to have the same pull!

Whenever I’m in a new city, I make it a point to explore its traditional flavors. In Mumbai, Malvani food is always on my list. Since I was staying near Malad West, I decided to try Surmai, a Malvani/Mangalorean restaurant.
We ordered quite a few dishes, and while there were some good ones, the experience was mixed overall. Unfortunately, the signature dishes were a letdown. The fish curry in the thali was bland, lacking any real flavor, and the fish itself seemed like old stock. The bangda/mackerel fry was also disappointing, with fish that tasted frozen and not fresh.
On the brighter side, the clam sukka and prawn rava fry were enjoyable and definitely stood out. The sol kadhi, however, was more about color than taste and lacked the authentic punch.
I wish the restaurant paid more attention to freshness and flavor, especially in their star dishes, because Malvani food deserves much better representation.

featured_reviews.review_text: A great place to dine with family and friends. Ordered the thalis prawn and surmai...and trust me it was lip smacking .. perfectly cooked and taste was authentic. My daughter was taken back to the konkan coast. Service was upto the mark and food was superb. I highly recommend this place for seafood lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Natasha Dsilva
featured_reviews.review_text: A fantastic experience every single time! The fish is always fresh!. Prices are very competitive and offer excellent value for the quality provided. What stands out even more is how well the fish is cleaned and prepared, saving so much time at home. Friendly service, fresh seafood, and fair pricing make this my go-to place for seafood! featured_reviews.name: R Wadia
featured_reviews.review_text: Great place to buy fresh fish from. We are regulars and everytime we have got good fresh fish. The delivery is also good. If you ask them to clean and devliver they will do that too. So the work at home is more easy.

featured_reviews.name: Ruth Lacroix
featured_reviews.review_text:
I buy my fish from The Fish Market all the time and have found the quality to be superior than most. Saves me the trouble of going to the market and haggling for fish that is very expensive too. The fish is always sent cleaned which also saves you a tedious amount of cleaning. The prices are reasonable especially compared to the Orlem fish market.
The service is very good, you are promptly responded to and the fish is delivered at the time promised. Overall, I'm grateful for a convenient, reliable and safe place to buy extremely fresh seafood from. Kudos to The Fish Market team for a job well done. I highly recommend anyone looking to buy seafood and cold cuts to give them a shot. Pls note this is an independent post and my feedback is purely my experience with them and not sponsored in any way.

featured_reviews.name: RAJESH MENON
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a seafood lover, I highly recommend FISH MARKET for their outstanding fresh fish delivery service. 🐟

Every order I’ve received has been incredibly fresh, clean, and of excellent quality. The fish tastes just like it came straight from the catch — which is rare to find with home deliveries these days.

What I really appreciate is their consistency. Order after order, the freshness and quality have remained top-notch. The packaging is neat, the service is reliable, and the overall experience has been excellent.

If you enjoy cooking seafood at home and want dependable quality, FISH MARKET is definitely worth trying. Highly recommended! 👍

featured_reviews.name: Angela Das
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the besttt shop in the Town with amazing staff..... The quality here is unmatched. You can tell the fish is incredibly fresh just by the color and the firm texture. I always keep buying fish and it cooks up beautifully. It’s hard to find a shop that maintains this level of excellence consistently. Worth every penny

featured_reviews.name: Avriel Dlima
featured_reviews.review_text: The fish market is “The best place” to get fresh fish and they deliver it free of cost to your door step. Their service is excellent. The owner Anthony and his staff are polite and very helpful. They maintain hygiene, they also cut and clean the fish as per your preference. The fish are very reasonable and plus they offer a lot of discounts. Thank you fish market for making it so easy to buy fresh fish. Kudos to you 👏🏻

featured_reviews.name: Chrystal Mascarenhas
featured_reviews.review_text: Convenience at its finest! FISH MARKET delivers fresh seafood right to my doorstep at unbeatable prices. I've been a loyal customer for years, and Anthony's service has always exceeded my expectations. Consistency is key, and FISH MARKET delivers every time. A must-try for anyone looking for quality seafood and exceptional customer service!

featured_reviews.name: Lalitha Balan
featured_reviews.review_text: Good quality fish with a wide variety of fresh options. The quality is consistently maintained, the service is cordial and helpful, and Mr. Anthony is always happy to guide you. The convenience of home delivery makes the entire experience smooth and hassle-free. Definitely a reliable place for fresh seafood.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Awesome local bar in Malad. Go for the cheap booze and good food, ignore the aesthetics if it's not your scene.
We always have a good time here.
Last time our server was a little aloof so we found it hilarious but overall everyone there is super sweet and helpful. They have a non-ac and ac section both, so take your pick.
Music, matches, or the news keep playing on the tv so you have some background noise too. The crowd is decent as well.

featured_reviews.name: manab dutta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nestled in the bustling heart of West Malad, Coastal Food and Spirits is a delightful culinary gem that captures the essence of coastal cuisine with a charming ambiance. As one steps inside, the warm decor featuring calm ambience and soft lighting creates an inviting atmosphere that feels perfect for both casual dining and special occasions. Although the name would bring the impression of sea food variety, but it didnot have a lot of option. However, the limited sea food options available are perfectly balanced, highlighting the freshness of the ingredients.
The restaurant also features an impressive selection of spirits and cocktails that pair beautifully with the spicy dishes, making it an ideal spot for those looking to unwind.

The staff at Coastal Food and Spirits are friendly and attentive, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. They are knowledgeable about the menu and can recommend dishes based on your preferences, which is always a plus.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Service is too bad here as no one's there to attend or listen to you or take your orders .You need to remind 2-3 times for small small requests be it Finger bowl or extra food or menu .Manyitems aren't available when neededbto order .Service time is almost 20-30 min per order.

featured_reviews.review_text:
